selection_reasoning: These 4 tasks form a coherent multi-hop sequence centered around wood-based items. The player first needs to find spruce_stairs (navigation/exploration task) which leads them to an area where they can mine a spruce_pressure_plate. The mined pressure plate demonstrates the concept of pressure plates, and the player then needs to craft a dark_oak_pressure_plate (requiring dark_oak_planks). The dark_oak_planks needed for the pressure plate also serve as a prerequisite for crafting a dark_oak_sign (which requires 6 dark_oak_planks + 1 stick). This creates a branching dependency where finding the spruce area leads to mining, and the crafting tasks share a common resource (dark_oak_planks) with the sign being more resource-intensive. The tasks are observable, verifiable, and don't require deep Minecraft knowledge beyond basic crafting.
